premises.text: Customer service is inefficient and frustrating for callers
premises.evidence_span: Customer service is terrible. It sucks to wait on hold, it sucks to spell out your name and address, and it really sucks when you get disconnected and have to do it all over again.

premises.text: Exchanging information over the phone is difficult
premises.evidence_span: the phone's a great tool for conversation, but it's a horrendous tool to exchange bits of information.

premises.text: Sending caller profiles to agents can streamline customer service calls
premises.evidence_span: we send your profile to the answering agent at the time of your call via our API.

premises.text: Companies can save money by reducing the time spent on information exchange during calls
premises.evidence_span: a sufficient exchange of information saves businesses so much money, they reward you by letting you skip the hold line.

premises.text: Next Caller can integrate easily with existing call center software
premises.evidence_span: Companies using Zendesk, Five9, and Salesforce to manage their call centers can easily integrate the Next Caller application and be live and running, live within minutes.

premises.text: Next Caller allows users to securely store and share billing information
premises.evidence_span: callers to save their bill information to the Next Caller profile.

premises.text: The volume of customer service calls is significant and increasing
premises.evidence_span: Last year in the United States, customers made 48 billion calls to customer service.

premises.text: Next Caller can identify a large number of phone numbers without user sign-up
premises.evidence_span: we can already identify 180 million U.S. phone numbers.

value.text: Customer service can be made faster and more efficient through automated information exchange
value.evidence_span: Just customer service without all the hassle.

notes: No separate premises for integration with call center software and secure billing information as they are part of the same operational capability.
